tolerance_rationale: Shad bala aggregates sthana/kaala/dig/cheshta/naisargika/drik balas, each summed over all seven planet positions and several divisional charts. After fixing the structural saptavargaja D-2 (hora chart_method=2) bug, the only residual is ephemeris drift between Python's JPL and the TS Moshier/WASM ephemerides, amplified through the sums; the worst cell differs by 0.5 (~1.2% rel) while the prior structural divergence was 15-30 units (>10%). Tolerance kept below the structural-bug magnitude.
